description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of various plots in Homagama. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related legal determinations.
